name: ref-image-handwritten-v3-image-model
render_engine: Gemini Images API with direct reference-image inputs

invariants.background: warm cream paper with a soft edge vignette
invariants.headline: oversized black brush-marker lettering
invariants.emphasis: one rough yellow highlighted phrase with hand-drawn underline
invariants.illustrations: simple thick-outline technical doodles on purple, mint, blue, orange, pink, or yellow blocks
invariants.cta: black brush panel appears on slide 5 only

layouts.1: curiosity cover: hero hook, short explanation, large mascot, compact 2x2 doodle grid, swipe cue
layouts.2: tension/mechanism: hero statement, four-part horizontal flow, pink note, large mascot
layouts.3: insight: hero statement, four-part horizontal flow, mascot, outlined speech bubble
layouts.4: application: hero statement, four-part horizontal flow, pink note, large mascot
layouts.5: payoff: hero statement, handwritten checklist, large black CTA, large mascot, connected pink save note

forbidden: black CTA repeated on slides 1 through 4
